findings.title: Advanced Urgent Care — limitation of CLIA certificate for Routine Chemistry
findings.exact_supporting_passage: will be limited for the subspecialty of Routine Chemistry due to their failure to meet CLIA requirements.
findings.access_consequences: CMS notice states Routine Chemistry CLIA certificate limitation will take effect November 25, 2026 at 10 Orland Square Dr., Orland Park, IL 60462. The lab may not perform clinical-purpose testing or report results in the limited testing area during the limitation. No evidence of closure of urgent-care services or of all laboratory service lines.
findings.affected_population: Patients relying on the Advanced Urgent Care laboratory for routine chemistry tests; patient count unknown.
